summary: The filing is a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) by Carlyle Credit Income Fund disclosing an unaudited net asset value per common share of $3.54 as of May 31, 2026. It is a routine NAV disclosure with no special-situation event—no acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The filing contains only a single line of substantive disclosure. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation.
